tools.name: git
tools.why: tools/daemonarchy/test_build.py runs bare `git -C` in temp repositories; the bootstrap seed has no git (its selection lists no git). build.py itself also runs `git` for its --revision/clean-checkout check

ambient.name: make
ambient.why: build.py native_preflight requires /usr/bin/make by absolute path; make drives buildworld/buildkernel

ambient.name: cc
ambient.why: build.py native_preflight requires /usr/bin/cc; the world build bootstraps from the host compiler

ambient.name: pkg
ambient.why: build.py sets PKG_CMD=/usr/local/sbin/pkg and requires it

ambient.name: atf-sh
ambient.why: test_report_kyua.py requires /usr/libexec/atf-sh by absolute path or skips

ambient.name: kyua-host
ambient.why: host kyua; the seed carries a copy, which must be byte-identical for the seed to describe the host

ambient.name: git-core-libexec
ambient.why: compiled-in git exec path (git --exec-path); the captured git cannot relocate it
